settings: Additive v1 local preference; missing/unknown preset becomes Maximum; Apply commits before camera change; discard/failed writes preserve accepted rendering.
camera_and_haze: One authored camera range owner; camera-eye-depth smoothstep from 75% of selected range to actual separately rendered directional sky. Maximum adds no fade. Volumetric dust availability is independent.
sky_depth_repair: Solid-color control proved native panorama sky cube overwrote geometry near a shortened clip. Force sky vertex depth to far plane; preserve artwork/mapping. Exact clear-depth classification prevents final terrain metres skipping the fade.

coverage: migration, persistence, Apply/discard/failed saves, menu layout/navigation
GPU visible-geometry control, near-ground identity, near-clip convergence, nonzero depth fade, off-axis planar mid-band blend at both twilight exposures

validation_boundary: Isolated committed 1024-tile terrain plus exact staged candidate. Live broader validator encountered a concurrent unowned north/r12_c05 TerrainData height mismatch (~18m); that asset and other dirty work were preserved. No gameplay smoke or Player launch is represented by this receipt.
performance_boundary: Offscreen render/readback timings are Editor diagnostics, not Player FPS. Draw counters unavailable. Representative Player CPU/GPU frame times and user visual/gameplay acceptance remain pending.
future_transparency: Distance composite is before transparents. Current production contact-band material is absent; future distant transparent content needs its own distance treatment.

build.note: The build uses committed terrain and excludes concurrent art/terrain changes. Later changes to the Editor-only capture helper do not alter packaged runtime code or assets.

foreground: Background-only Unity launch/capture/test/build; task-owned Editor closed; user foreground preserved.
